<div style="border:2px solid #b32424; background:#fdf2f2; padding:0.8em 1em; margin-bottom:1em; font-size:110%;">
'''Working draft, not a public article.''' A decision sheet in [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]]'s user space for [[Bill Bisco]]: one row per Virtual Legacy card whose printed title differs from its Players Committee title. Card pages and GEMP stay as they are until Bill picks.
</div>

'''How to answer:''' reply in chat with picks by GEMP id, for example "1273_6 printed, 1273_9 PC", or give one answer for a whole table ("Table C: PC for all").
* '''Printed''' = the title on the physical card, as printed on the Players Committee's official card sheet.
* '''PC''' = the Players Committee's title in its card data, which the Players Committee's GEMP uses.
* '''Current''' = what GEMP (billbisco/swccg-gemp master, 4 November 2026) and the wiki use now.
* Card images are the Players Committee's card images on the wiki. The sheet page for each card is in Sources.

== Summary ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Table !! What differs !! Cards !! Printings
|-
| [[#A. Different names|A]] || A different name || 26 || 32
|-
| [[#B. Spelling|B]] || Spelling of the same name || 4 || 4
|-
| [[#C. Qualifier labels|C]] || A label in parentheses (side, edition, marker, host card) || 16 + 14 twin slips || 17 + 14
|-
| [[#D. Minor differences|D]] || (V) suffix, uniqueness dots, capitalization, punctuation, accents || 73 || 75
|}
Not counted: 176 titles that differ only in typography (curly or straight apostrophes, the sheet PDF's split "fi" and "fl" letters, a space after a uniqueness dot), 12 that differ only by the AI marker, and 9 objectives whose sheet heading shows the front title only.

'''Facts for deciding'''
* GEMP titles follow the PC on every coded card in these tables except [[Grievous' Lightsabers]] (1274_11), which GEMP titles "Cyborg Commander's Lightsabers", and [[Planetary Shiel]] (1273_31), where the PC title is missing its last letter.
* GEMP's card text for the 7.3 and 7.4 cards follows the printed sheets ("Cyborg Commander", "Spice Mine Administrator", "The Count"), while the code finds those cards by their PC names or persona.<ref name="pr482" />
* The wiki card pages use the PC titles.
* Later sheets print the character names: the 8.3 sheet's [[Black Market Blaster]] says "Kyle Katarn", and 9.1 and 9.2 cards say "Jango".<ref name="VirtualBlock8_3" /><ref name="VirtualBlock9_1" /><ref name="VirtualBlock9_2" />

'''Ways to decide'''
# Card by card, in the tables below.
# One rule for all: printed everywhere, or PC everywhere.
# One title for GEMP deck matching and the wiki page title, with the other shown on the card page as "Printed as" (or as the PC title), so both names stay searchable.

| <ref name="VirtualBlock9_2" /> p.&nbsp;2
|}

== How the list was built ==
* Every one of the 1,203 Legacy printings: the PC title<ref name="pcjson" /> against the heading on its official sheet.
* Every Legacy card's game text, on the sheets and in the PC data, searched for both names of each card in tables A and B.
* GEMP titles read from master (after [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/pull/482 PR #482]) and from the unmerged branches legacy/p-vb7-2-a, legacy/p-vb7-2-light-b and legacy/p-vb7-1-dark-a named in Claude's handoff on swccg-guild/work issue #5 (a private repository).<ref name="hw71" />
